title: Recursive Self-Improvement in Unified Multimodal Models
title_zh: 统一多模态模型中的递归自我改进

paragraphs.en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) understand and generate both text and images, which lets a model produce its own training data. Existing self-improvement in UMMs keeps supervision on the visual side, where image understanding judges image generation. We propose recursive cross-capability self-improvement (RSI), a training loop in which the text and visual abilities of a UMM supply training data for one another. In each round, the model generates images and reads them to find where it falls short. It then writes programs aimed at these shortcomings, and execution verifies every result against its specification. Verified renders train image generation, while labeled renders and the model’s own correct programs train visual understanding and program writing. Program execution thus acts as a source of truth outside the model, so errors do not accumulate across rounds. We study RSI on charts and build BasicChartBench to evaluate open models early in training. On requests worded differently from training, four rounds of RSI raise the score from 45.7% to 60.2%, while continued training stays at 46.3%. Verified construction carries most of the gain, and targeting the model’s failures adds 3.5%. Along the way, the share of verified programs rises from 48.9% to 95.2%, and the reader’s accuracy on edited renders rises from 55.6% to 87.4%.
paragraphs.zh: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）能够理解和生成文本与图像，这使得模型可以自行生成训练数据。 UMMs 现有的自我改进机制仍将监督集中在视觉部分，即通过图像理解来评估图像生成效果。 我们提出了递归跨能力自我改进（RSI），这是一种训练循环，其中 UMM 的文本和视觉能力相互提供训练数据。 在每一轮中，模型会生成图像，并通过解读这些图像来发现自身存在的不足。 随后，模型会编写针对这些不足的程序，并通过执行来验证每个结果是否符合其规范。 经过验证的渲染结果用于训练图像生成能力，而带有标签的渲染结果和模型自身正确的程序则用于训练视觉理解和程序编写能力。 因此，程序执行成为模型外部的真理来源，从而避免了错误在轮次之间累积。 我们在图表任务上研究了 RSI，并构建了 BasicChartBench，用于在训练早期评估开放模型。 对于与训练数据措辞不同的请求，四轮 RSI 使得分从 45.7% 提升至 60.2%，而继续训练则停留在 46.3%。 经过验证的构建过程贡献了大部分提升，而针对模型失败点的优化则额外带来了 3.5% 的提升。 在此过程中，经过验证的程序比例从 48.9% 上升至 95.2%，而阅读器对编辑后渲染结果的准确率也从 55.6% 提升至 87.4%。

paragraphs.en: Progress in foundation models has largely been driven by data that humans collect, filter, and annotate. Unified multimodal models (UMMs) suggest a different path. A UMM understands and generates both text and images within a single model ( Chameleon Team, 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) . It could therefore produce its own training data, with one ability supervising another. Self-improvement of this kind has already advanced the reasoning of language models ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ) . In UMMs, image understanding has recently begun to reward or filter the outputs of image generation ( Mao et al., 2025 ; Jin et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) . This supervision stays on the visual side, and the text abilities of the model take no part in it.
paragraphs.zh: 基础模型的发展在很大程度上依赖于人类收集、筛选和标注的数据。 统一的多模态模型（UMMs）提出了一条不同的路径。 UMM 能够在单一模型内理解和生成文本与图像（Chameleon Team, 2024；Zhou et al., 2025；Deng et al., 2025）。 因此，它有可能自行生成训练数据，使一种能力对另一种能力进行监督。 这种自我改进已经推动了语言模型的推理能力（Zelikman et al., 2022；Yuan et al., 2024）。 在 UMMs 中，图像理解最近开始对图像生成的输出进行奖励或筛选（Mao et al., 2025；Jin et al., 2026；Fang et al., 2026）。 这种监督仅停留在视觉层面，模型的文本能力并未参与其中。

paragraphs.en: We ask whether the text and visual abilities of a UMM can improve one another in a closed loop. Image generation shows what the model cannot yet draw. Visual understanding finds what is wrong, and text generation describes what should be drawn instead. Each ability turns what it finds into training data for the others. Round after round, the data follow the model’s changing weaknesses ( Zhao et al., 2024 ; Khan et al., 2025 ) , and each gain strengthens the abilities that build the next round. The risk is that the loop feeds on its own outputs. Without an independent check, the errors of one round are learned in the next, and they compound over rounds ( Shumailov et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们想知道，UMM 的文本和视觉能力是否能在一个闭环中相互提升。 图像生成展示了模型目前还无法绘制的内容。 视觉理解能发现其中的问题，而文本生成则描述出应当替代绘制的正确内容。 每种能力都会将其发现的内容转化为另一种能力的训练数据。 一轮接一轮地循环中，数据会跟随模型不断变化的弱点（Zhao et al., 2024; Khan et al., 2025），而每一次进步都会强化构建下一轮所需的能力。 风险在于，这个闭环可能会持续依赖自身生成的结果。 如果没有独立的验证机制，一轮中的错误会在下一轮中被继承并学习，从而在循环中不断累积（Shumailov et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: The loop therefore needs a source of truth outside the model. For structured visual content, programs provide one. Infographics, diagrams, tables, and documents can all be written as programs ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Zhuo et al., 2026 ) . Running a program yields an image and an exact record of what it contains, so correctness comes from execution rather than from the model’s own judgment. Building on this idea, we propose recursive cross-capability self-improvement (RSI). In each round, the model generates images and reads them to find where it falls short. It then writes programs aimed at these shortcomings, and execution verifies every result. Verified renders train image generation. Labeled renders and the model’s own correct programs train visual understanding and program writing (Figure 1 ). The model decides what to learn, and execution ensures that its data are correct.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，该循环需要一个位于模型之外的真相来源。 对于结构化视觉内容，程序可以提供这样的来源。 信息图、图表、表格和文档都可以被编写为程序（Yang et al., 2025；Zhuo et al., 2026）。 运行程序会产生一张图像以及对其内容的精确记录，因此正确性源于执行过程，而非模型自身的判断。 基于这一理念，我们提出了递归跨能力自我改进（RSI）方法。 在每一轮中，模型会生成图像并读取这些图像，以发现自身存在的不足。 随后，它会针对这些不足编写程序，并通过执行来验证每一项结果。 经过验证的渲染结果可用于训练图像生成能力。 带标签的渲染结果以及模型自身正确的程序可用于训练视觉理解能力和程序编写能力（图1）。 模型决定学习的内容，而执行过程则确保其数据是正确的。

On requests worded differently from training, the score rises from 45.7% to 60.2%, while continued training on the original data stays near its starting point. Verified construction carries most of this gain, and building data where the model fails adds to it. The text and visual abilities also improve along the way. After one round, the model writes a correct program for almost every planned example, and its reader catches far more of the errors planted in rendered charts. We close by analyzing in detail where the loop does not yet help.

paragraphs.en: Fixed rules turn the diagnosis into a data plan, a sampling distribution π t \pi_{t} over specifications. The plan specifies kinds of examples rather than individual charts. It first sets how many specifications to build for each pair of chart type and capability dimension. A fixed 20% of the budget is spread evenly to keep learned skills practiced. The rest follows the diagnosed error rates, with each pair’s weight capped at three times the mean. Each dimension of each chart type has a current difficulty level. The level moves up when its generation accuracy reaches 80% and down when it falls below 60%. Within a pair, the dimension being trained uses its current level for 70% of specifications, the next harder level for 20%, and an easier level for 10%. Other dimensions stay at or below their current levels.
paragraphs.zh: 固定规则将诊断过程转化为一个数据计划，即针对规格的一个采样分布 π t \pi_{t}。 该计划规定的是示例的类型，而非具体的图表。 它首先设定了每种图表类型与能力维度组合需要构建的规格数量。 预算中固定的 20% 会被平均分配，以确保已学到的技能得到持续练习。 剩余部分则根据诊断出的错误率进行分配，且每对组合的权重上限为平均值的三倍。 每种图表类型的每个维度都有一个当前的难度等级。 当生成准确率达到 80% 时，该等级会提升；当低于 60% 时，则会降低。 在一对组合中，正在训练的维度有 70% 的规格使用其当前等级，20% 使用下一个更高难度等级，10% 使用更简单的等级。 其他维度则保持在当前等级或低于当前等级。

paragraphs.en: The plan then sets attribute values. An attribute value is weak when its generation accuracy is well below the best value of the same attribute and below a mastery level. A weak value may lack training data, or it may be hard despite frequent training, and the two cases call for different data. The rules therefore check how often the value appears in all earlier training data. A value that almost never appears is introduced, and a rare value receives more examples. A common value that is still weak also receives more examples, and the reader receives more examples of it with errors to find. A value that is correct under one request wording and wrong under another is paired with the weaker wording. A curriculum widens the space of specifications when fixed gates are met. For example, it adds a number format once accuracy on the current formats reaches 80%. Table 4 lists all thresholds.
paragraphs.zh: 该计划随后会设置属性值。 当一个属性值的生成准确率远低于同一属性的最佳值，且低于掌握水平时，该属性值即为薄弱值。 薄弱值可能缺乏训练数据，也可能在频繁训练后仍难以正确生成；这两种情况需要不同的数据支持。 因此，规则会检查该值在所有早期训练数据中出现的频率。 对于几乎从未出现的值，系统会引入它；对于罕见的值，则会提供更多示例。 即使常见但依然薄弱的值也会获得更多示例，并且读者还会看到更多包含错误需要查找的此类示例。 对于在不同请求措辞下表现正确或错误的值，系统会将其与较弱的措辞配对。 当固定条件得到满足时，课程计划会扩展规格的覆盖范围。 例如，一旦当前格式的准确率达到了 80%，系统就会添加一种新的数字格式。 表 4 列出了所有阈值。

paragraphs.en: Levels. Every chart has one panel. Open models render unfamiliar words poorly, and learning to render arbitrary text needs more training than our budget allows, so the two levels separate familiar text from rare text. Level L0 has 336 charts, 48 for each of the seven chart types, and 10,140 questions. It keeps the vocabulary of the first curriculum stage but uses a request wording that never appears in training. paragraphs.en: We build on BAGEL-7B-MoT ( Deng et al., 2025 ) . The starting model M 0 M_{0} comes from a curriculum that goes from easy to hard. The model first learns to write plotting programs. Generation then learns basic chart types with short text, followed by a larger set of programmatically generated charts. Finally, the understanding parameters learn to answer atomic questions about program-rendered charts (Appendix A.1 ). The tasks cover seven chart types that verification can check: vertical bars, horizontal bars, lines, scatter plots, areas, pies, and rings. A diagnostic set of 336 requests in the vocabulary of the first curriculum stage drives the data plan in every round. It varies the series count, value size, and request wording. Every round uses the same training budget (Appendix A ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法基于 BAGEL-7B-MoT（Deng 等人，2025）。 初始模型 M₀ 来自一个从简单到复杂的课程学习流程。 该模型首先学习编写绘图程序。 随后，生成模块学习使用简短文本创建基本图表类型，接着学习由程序生成的更大规模图表集。 最后，理解参数学习回答关于程序渲染图表的原子性问题（附录 A.1）。 这些任务涵盖七种可通过验证检查的图表类型：垂直条形图、水平条形图、折线图、散点图、面积图、饼图和环形图。 首个课程阶段词汇表中的 336 条诊断请求，在每一轮中驱动数据规划。 这些请求会变化序列数量、数值大小和表述方式。 每一轮都使用相同的训练预算（附录 A）。

paragraphs.en: Controls. Each control removes one part of RSI. Continued training trains the generator from M 0 M_{0} for the same number of steps on the original data mixture of M 0 M_{0} and tests whether the gain comes only from more training. The self-filtered control replaces programs and verification with the reader. It samples two images per request from M 0 M_{0} and trains on the one that U 0 U_{0} scores higher. The fixed distribution builds the same number of verified charts in each round with the same writer and understanding update as RSI, but it spreads them evenly over pairs of chart type and capability dimension and keeps the first curriculum stage. Single diagnosis builds the plan of every round from the diagnosis of M 0 M_{0} and never diagnoses again. The frozen reader diagnoses every round with U 0 U_{0} instead of the updated reader. The last two share the first round and understanding updates with RSI.

sents.zh: 自过滤控制用阅读器取代了程序和验证。

sents.en: It samples two images per request from M 0 M_{0} and trains on the one that U 0 U_{0} scores higher.
sents.zh: 它每次请求从 M 0 M_{0} 中采样两张图像，并以 U 0 U_{0} 评分更高的那张进行训练。

sents.en: The fixed distribution builds the same number of verified charts in each round with the same writer and understanding update as RSI, but it spreads them evenly over pairs of chart type and capability dimension and keeps the first curriculum stage.
sents.zh: 固定分布在每轮中使用相同的写者和与 RSI 相同的理解更新来构建相同数量的已验证图表，但会将其均匀地分布在图表类型和能力维度的组合上，并保留第一个课程阶段。

sents.en: Single diagnosis builds the plan of every round from the diagnosis of M 0 M_{0} and never diagnoses again.
sents.zh: 单次诊断会根据 M 0 M_{0} 的诊断结果构建每一轮的计划，且不再进行诊断。

sents.en: The frozen reader diagnoses every round with U 0 U_{0} instead of the updated reader.
sents.zh: 冻结阅读器在每轮中都会使用 U 0 U_{0} 而非更新后的阅读器进行诊断。

sents.en: The last two share the first round and understanding updates with RSI.
sents.zh: 最后两种方法与 RSI 共享第一轮和理解的更新。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows generation on BasicChartBench, with its two levels pooled. The score rises in every round, from 45.5% at the start to 52.8%, 56.1%, 57.4%, and 59.0% in the four rounds. Continued training stays near the start (46.3% after round 4), and the fixed distribution reaches 54.9%. The gain holds on both levels, which reach 60.2% on L0 and 56.2% on L1 (Table 1 ). The external judge shows the same trend, rising from 37.4% to 57.9% on L0 and from 37.5% to 50.0% on L1 (Appendix C ). Retraining one round’s generator with other seeds moves its score by at most 0.4%.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 展示了在 BasicChartBench 上的生成结果，其中两个层级被合并处理。 分数在每一轮中均有所上升，从初始的 45.5% 依次增至 52.8%、56.1%、57.4% 和 59.0%。 持续训练后的分数仍接近初始水平（第 4 轮后为 46.3%），而固定分布则达到了 54.9%。 两个层级的提升幅度均保持稳定，L0 达到 60.2%，L1 达到 56.2%（表 1）。 外部评估结果也呈现出相同趋势：L0 的分数从 37.4% 升至 57.9%，L1 的分数从 37.5% 升至 50.0%（附录 C）。 使用其他种子对某一轮的生成器进行重新训练，其分数最多仅变化 0.4%。

paragraphs.en: Most of the gain comes from text and binding. After four rounds, text accuracy is 88.2% against 56.0% at the start, binding is 27.3% against 13.6%, and OCR character similarity is 80.6% against 47.8%. Binding improves partly because text improves. After four rounds, binding accuracy is 34.0% on charts whose category labels are all correct and 25.4% on the others, while at the start the two differ by about 1%. Structure changes much less, as Section 4.5 discusses.

paragraphs.en: Execution supplies correct examples. For each of the 15,320 requests of our first round, the self-filtered control keeps the better of two images from M 0 M_{0} and trains the generator for the same 400 steps. It stays near the start, 0.5% higher on L0 and 1.2% higher on L1. A first-round generator trained on verified charts for the same requests and steps gains 8.6% on L0 and 4.2% on L1. Finding an error does not supply a correct example to learn from, and program execution does.
paragraphs.zh: 执行过程提供了正确的示例。 在我们第一轮的全部 15,320 个请求中，自过滤控制机制会保留来自 M 0 M_{0} 的两张图像中较好的一张，并对生成器进行相同的 400 步训练。 它保持在起点附近，L0 上高 0.5%，L1 上高 1.2%。 使用相同请求和步骤在已验证图表上训练的第一轮生成器，在 L0 上提升了 8.6%，在 L1 上提升了 4.2%。 发现错误并不会提供可供学习的正确示例，而程序执行则会提供。

paragraphs.en: Diagnosis decides which examples to build. The fixed distribution keeps everything of RSI except the diagnosis. RSI leads it in every round, by 2.8 to 4.1% on L0 and by 1.7 to 5.5% on L1 (Table 1 ). Choosing examples from the errors in the model’s own outputs therefore adds to what verified charts alone provide, and Figure 5 shows one such case in detail. paragraphs.en: Recursion follows the changing model. As the model learns, its errors change, and each understanding update also changes how the reader judges them. Single diagnosis removes the first effect, and the frozen reader removes the second. Both stay close to RSI on L0. On L1, RSI leads single diagnosis by 3.1 and 3.7% in rounds 3 and 4, and it leads the frozen reader by 2.3% in round 3. Diagnosing the changing model thus matters most on the harder level, while updating the reader matters less. Recursion also changes the writer, whose improvement we examine in the next section.
paragraphs.zh: 递归模型会随模型的变化而变化。 随着模型不断学习，其错误也会随之改变，而每一次理解上的更新也会改变读者判断这些错误的方式。 单次诊断消除了第一种影响，而冻结的读者则消除了第二种影响。 两者在 L0 上都与 RSI 保持接近。 在 L1 上，第 3 轮和第 4 轮中，RSI 分别比单次诊断领先 3.1% 和 3.7%，并在第 3 轮比冻结的读者领先 2.3%。 因此，在难度更高的层级上，诊断不断变化的模型最为关键，而更新读者的作用则相对较小。 递归模型也会改变写作者，我们将在下一节中探讨其改进情况。

paragraphs.en: Program writing. With the starting model, 70% of the candidate programs run but only 34% pass verification, so about half of the programs that run draw the wrong content, and 48.9% of specifications receive a verified program. After one round the share is 95.2%, and it stays between 95% and 97% in later rounds, including the round that switches to new topics. Horizontal bars rise from 11.8% to 98.4%, and scatter plots from 23.4% to 90.9% (Appendix E ). Sampling the writer’s correct programs on weak values more often does not explain this gain. When we retrain the first-round understanding update with these programs drawn uniformly and every other example unchanged, the resulting writer passes verification on the same 5,376 second-round specifications at the same rate as ours (90.8% for both). As a side effect, writing the programs of a round takes 18 rather than 159 GPU hours, so each new round of data is much faster to build.

paragraphs.en: Reading program renders. Correct renders test whether the reader confirms requirements that the image meets. Held-out edited renders come from first-round specifications that no round trains on, so every reader is measured on the same images. On questions whose answer the edit changes, a reader that answers from the request instead of the image is wrong. On correct renders, accuracy rises from 87.1% to 99.3% after four rounds, and binding rises from 77.4% to 98.5%. On changed questions, accuracy rises from 55.6% to 86.5% after one round and then stays near 87%. The reader therefore looks at the image more closely rather than simply accepting more requirements. Building the reading data from the diagnosis brings no measurable benefit, however. A first-round reader trained on questions built from the fixed distribution instead answers 86.3% of the changed questions on the held-out edits of RSI, against 86.5% for our reader, so the two do equally well.
paragraphs.zh: 阅读程序生成渲染结果。 正确的渲染结果用于测试阅读器是否确认图像满足要求。 预留的编辑后渲染结果来自首轮未参与训练的规范，因此每位阅读器都基于相同的图像进行评估。 对于答案被编辑改变的问题，如果阅读器依据请求而非图像作答，则视为错误。 在正确渲染结果上，经过四轮训练后，准确率从 87.1% 提升至 99.3%，绑定率从 77.4% 提升至 98.5%。 在被修改的问题上，经过一轮训练后，准确率从 55.6% 提升至 86.5%，之后则稳定在 87% 附近。 因此，阅读器会更仔细地审视图像，而不仅仅是接受更多要求。 然而，根据诊断结果构建阅读数据并未带来任何可测量的益处。 相反，使用固定分布构建的问题进行训练的首轮阅读器，在 RSI 预留编辑后的被修改问题上准确率为 86.3%，与我们的阅读器 86.5% 的准确率相当，两者表现相同。

paragraphs.en: Reading the model’s own generations. Program renders cannot show whether the reader also reads the model’s own generations, which are the input of every diagnosis. A blind human audit of 392 questions on these generations answers this question (Appendix D ). Accuracy rises only from 78.5% for U 0 U_{0} to 82.4% for U 3 U_{3} (Table 2 ), and every reader still accepts about a third of the requirements that humans mark as not shown. The external judge agrees, since the updated readers match it on 83% to 84% of questions, no more than U 0 U_{0} does. The reader ranks weaknesses well, however. Across pairs of chart type and question group, the Spearman correlation between the violation rates measured by the reader and by humans is 0.82 for U 0 U_{0} and 0.86 to 0.91 for later readers. The allocation rules depend on this ranking rather than on exact rates, so the diagnosis points the data to the right places even though many real errors in the model’s own images still go unreported by the reader.

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks and general abilities. On the chart subset of StructT2IBench (933 charts, 24,925 questions), scored by the external judge with its official questions, RSI raises the score only from 11.0% to 11.9% (Table 3 ), and continued training reaches 11.7% after 400 steps. On the chart subset of BizGenEval, every model answers about 4% of the questions correctly, and no image passes all of its checks. These benchmarks remain too hard for open models. RSI keeps general generation but costs some general understanding (Table 3 ). GenEval is 82.9 at the start and between 83.7 and 84.5 after every round, while after four rounds the reader is 2.6% lower on MMBench and 3.0% lower on MMMU. Only 5% of each round’s reader data is general visual data.

paragraphs.en: Unified Multimodal Models. Unified multimodal models provide a shared foundation for visual understanding and generation, spanning different choices of visual representation, modeling objective, and joint training ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) . Beyond architectural unification, interleaved multimodal reasoning connects these capabilities within a task: generated images become intermediate representations that the model can interpret and reason over ( Li et al., 2026a ; Qin et al., 2026 ) . This makes the interaction between understanding and generation a central aspect of unified modeling. We examine this interaction across training rounds, where understanding the model’s own visual outputs informs the construction of its subsequent training data.
paragraphs.zh: 统一多模态模型。 统一多模态模型为视觉理解与生成提供了共享基础，涵盖了不同的视觉表示方式、建模目标以及联合训练方法（Xie 等，2025；Wu 等，2025；Deng 等，2025）。 除了架构上的统一，交错式多模态推理还在任务内部将这些能力连接起来：生成的图像成为模型可以解读和推理的中间表示（Li 等，2026a；Qin 等，2026）。 这使得理解与生成之间的交互成为统一建模的核心环节。 我们跨多个训练轮次考察这种交互，其中模型对其自身视觉输出的理解会影响后续训练数据的构建。

paragraphs.en: Recursive Self-Improvement. Recursive self-improvement couples model updates with the supervision used in later training rounds. Existing approaches recover learning signals from self-generated outputs through outcome verification or learned evaluation ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ) , and extend this process to adaptive task construction when execution supplies verifiable feedback ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Heng et al., 2026 ) . For unified multimodal models, the relationship between understanding and generation provides an additional source of supervision through cross-modal consistency and self-generated visual experience ( Hong et al., 2026 ; Thawkar et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Hao et al., 2026 ) . These studies motivate examining how feedback quality evolves alongside the model being trained. Our focus is the role of updated visual understanding in this process: how learning to recognize generation errors changes the examples constructed for subsequent training.
paragraphs.zh: 递归自我改进。 递归自我改进将模型更新与后续训练轮次中使用的监督机制相结合。 现有方法通过结果验证或学习到的评估（Zelikman 等，2022；Yuan 等，2024）从自生成输出中恢复学习信号，并在执行过程提供可验证反馈时，将这一过程扩展到自适应任务构建（Zhao 等，2025；Heng 等，2026）。 对于统一的多模态模型，理解与生成之间的关系通过跨模态一致性和自生成的视觉经验提供了额外的监督来源（Hong 等，2026；Thawkar 等，2026；Fang 等，2026；Hao 等，2026）。 这些研究促使我们探究反馈质量如何随着被训练模型的发展而演变。 我们的重点是更新后的视觉理解在此过程中的作用：学习识别生成错误如何改变为后续训练构建的示例。

paragraphs.en: Synthetic Data Generation. The value of synthetic training data depends on both the reliability of its supervision and its relevance to the learner. Programmatic visual data construction exposes information about how examples are produced, supporting annotation and verification through rendering code and executable transformations ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Heng et al., 2026 ) . Adaptive data generation uses learner performance, quality feedback, and coverage gaps to guide the composition of the training set ( Khan et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) . These approaches address complementary aspects of data construction: verifying an example does not by itself establish its usefulness for the current model. Our method combines model-based error diagnosis with programmatic construction, using visual understanding to select training needs and execution records to verify the resulting examples and supervise their visible content.
paragraphs.zh: 合成数据生成。 合成训练数据的价值取决于其监督信息的可靠性以及其与学习者的相关性。 程序化的视觉数据构建会暴露示例生成方式的相关信息，通过渲染代码和可执行转换支持标注与验证（Yang et al., 2025；Heng et al., 2026）。 自适应数据生成利用学习者性能、质量反馈和覆盖缺口来指导训练集的构成（Khan et al., 2025；Zhao et al., 2024；Yan et al., 2026）。 这些方法解决了数据构建中相互补充的方面：仅验证一个示例本身并不能证明它对当前模型有用。 我们的方法将基于模型的错误诊断与程序化构建相结合，利用视觉理解来选择训练需求，并通过执行记录来验证生成的示例及其可见内容。

paragraphs.en: We proposed recursive cross-capability self-improvement, a loop in which the text and visual abilities of a UMM produce training data for one another and program execution keeps that data correct. On chart generation, four rounds raise the score on unseen request wording from 45.7% to 60.2%, while continued training on the original data stays near 46%, and an external judge shows the same trend. Verified construction carries the gain, targeting the model’s failures adds 3.5%, and program writing and reading improve along with generation. These results point toward a broader goal: models whose abilities keep supplying one another with correct training data as they improve.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了递归式跨能力自我改进方法，这是一种循环机制：通用多模态模型（UMM）的文本和视觉能力相互生成训练数据，而程序执行则确保这些数据保持正确。 在图表生成任务中，四轮迭代使模型对未见请求表述的准确率从45.7%提升至60.2%，而持续使用原始数据进行训练则使准确率维持在46%附近，外部评估也显示出相同趋势。 经过验证的构建方法带来了性能提升：针对模型薄弱环节的优化额外贡献了3.5%，程序编写与理解能力也随之生成能力的提升而得到改善。 这些结果指向一个更广泛的目标：构建能够持续相互提供正确训练数据、并在能力提升过程中不断自我强化的模型。

paragraphs.en: We start from BAGEL-7B-MoT ( Deng et al., 2025 ) and build M 0 M_{0} with a curriculum that goes from easy to hard. Program writing is first trained on paired ChartNet code and images with the generation parameters frozen. Generation is then trained with the understanding parameters frozen, first on basic chart types with short text and then on a larger set of programmatically generated charts. We use the checkpoint after 14,000 updates of this second stage. Finally, the understanding parameters learn to answer atomic questions about program-rendered charts while keeping program writing, with the generation parameters frozen. This last step starts from the same code-trained checkpoint and changes only the understanding parameters, so combining it with the generation checkpoint equals running it after generation training. The reader of M 0 M_{0} is U 0 U_{0} .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 BAGEL-7B-MoT（Deng 等人，2025）出发，通过一个由易到难的课程来构建 M₀ M_{0}。 首先，在成对的 ChartNet 代码和图像上进行程序编写训练，同时冻结生成参数。 接着，在冻结理解参数的情况下进行生成训练：先使用带有简短文本的基本图表类型，然后扩展到更大规模的程序生成图表集合。 我们使用这一第二阶段经过 14,000 次更新后的检查点。 最后，在保持程序编写功能不变（即冻结生成参数）的同时，理解参数学习回答关于程序渲染图表的原子性问题。 这最后一步从相同的代码训练检查点开始，仅改变理解参数，因此将其与生成检查点结合，等同于在生成训练之后运行它。 M₀ M_{0} 的读取器是 U₀ U_{0}。

paragraphs.en: Both updates start from the merged model of the previous round and use 64 GPUs. The generation update runs 400 steps with a global batch of 192 on 25,600 unique examples seen three times. It uses AdamW with β = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) \beta=(0.9,0.95) , a constant learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} after 100 warmup steps, and an exponential moving average with decay 0.995. Verified targets of the round make up 60% of the examples. From the second round on, 10% of these targets are replayed from earlier rounds, sampled evenly across pairs of chart type and capability dimension with double weight on pairs that are already mastered. Replay of the initial generation data makes up 20%, general images 15%, and editing pairs 5%.
paragraphs.zh: 两次更新都从上一轮的合并模型开始，并使用 64 块 GPU。 生成更新运行 400 步，全局批量大小为 192，基于 25,600 个唯一样本（每个样本被观察三次）。 该更新使用 AdamW，其中 β = (0.9, 0.95)，在 100 步预热后采用恒定的学习率 2 × 10⁻⁵，并使用衰减系数为 0.995 的指数移动平均。 该轮次中经过验证的目标样本占所有样本的 60%。 从第二轮开始，这些目标样本中有 10% 会从早期轮次中重复播放，按图表类型与能力维度的组合均匀采样，且对已掌握的组合赋予双倍权重。 初始生成数据的重复播放占比为 20%，通用图像占 15%，编辑组合占 5%。

paragraphs.en: Each round plans about 36,000 specifications, plus up to 20% more where the writer’s success rate is low. Some planned specifications cannot be generated within the retry limit and are dropped, so the rounds use about 35,000 to 43,000. About half of the requests use the curriculum contract wording and the rest use one of six structured forms. The model writes two candidate programs per specification, one greedy and one sampled at temperature 0.6, with at most 6,144 new tokens. A sandbox runs each program and records every panel. Verification checks the data, text, series and category colors, category order, axes and ticks, grid, value labels, legend, layout, and readability. We keep the first verified candidate per specification and fill each pair of chart type and capability dimension up to its share without borrowing from other pairs. If pairs fall short, we build extra specifications for them in proportion to their observed success rate. Only the first round needed this, with about 30,000 extra specifications.
paragraphs.zh: 每轮计划约 36,000 个规格，若作者的成功率较低，则最多再增加 20%。 部分已计划的规格无法在重试限制内生成，因此会被舍弃，所以各轮实际使用的规格约为 35,000 至 43,000 个。 约一半的请求使用课程合同措辞，其余则使用六种结构化形式之一。 该模型为每个规格生成两个候选程序：一个贪婪程序和一个在温度 0.6 下采样的程序，最多使用 6,144 个新词元。 一个沙盒运行每个程序并记录每一个面板。 验证环节会检查数据、文本、序列和类别颜色、类别顺序、坐标轴与刻度、网格、数值标签、图例、布局以及可读性。 我们保留每个规格中第一个通过验证的候选程序，并在不借用其他组合的前提下，将每种图表类型与能力维度的组合填充至其应得份额。 如果某些组合未能达到所需数量，我们会根据它们观察到的成功率，为这些组合生成额外的规格。 只有第一轮需要这样做，额外生成了约 30,000 个规格。

paragraphs.en: Diagnostic set. The diagnostic set uses the vocabulary of the first curriculum stage, which comes from 12 topics of the generation curriculum with one-word titles and axis titles. Every chart has one panel and three to five categories. For the five chart types with axes, the 48 requests cross the number of series (one, two, or three), the kind of series names (years or words), the size of the values (all below 100, or some at least 100), and the request wording (the curriculum contract or one of six structured forms), with two repeats. Area charts need at least two series, so their one-series cells use two. Pies and rings cross value size and wording with twelve repeats. The first repeat uses integers. The second uses decimals for small values and thousands separators for large values. The set has 9,636 questions. After the fourth round, the diagnostic set also gains a part for the second vocabulary, with the same design, 24 requests per chart type, and 4,814 questions. This part only feeds the data plan and the vocabulary gate, and it shares no content with any test set.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断集。 该诊断集使用第一阶段课程大纲的词汇，这些词汇来自生成课程大纲中 12 个标题为单个单词和轴标题的主题。 每张图表包含一个面板和三到五个类别。 对于五种带轴的图表类型，48 项请求涵盖了系列数量（一个、两个或三个）、系列名称的类型（年份或词语）、数值的大小（全部低于 100，或部分至少为 100）以及请求的措辞（课程大纲合同或六种结构化形式之一），并包含两次重复。 面积图需要至少两个系列，因此其单系列单元格会使用两个系列。 饼图和环形图则涉及数值大小和措辞的变化，共有十二种重复组合。 第一次重复使用整数。 第二次重复对较小数值使用小数，对较大数值使用千位分隔符。 该诊断集包含 9,636 个问题。 第四轮之后，诊断集还增加了一个针对第二阶段词汇的部分，设计相同，每种图表类型有 24 项请求，共 4,814 个问题。 该部分仅用于数据计划和词汇关卡，且与任何测试集都没有内容上的重叠。

paragraphs.zh: BasicChartBench L1。 L1 使用了 14 个主题，这些主题中的词汇在生成训练数据中极为罕见，例如金融、交通、医疗保健和音乐。 每张图表都有一个面板。 标题由两到三个词组成，图表包含一到四个系列，数字格式包括小数和百分比，而这些内容课程尚未涉及（图 2b）。它包含 4,300 个问题。

paragraphs.en: Question coverage. Structure questions cover the chart type, category count and spacing, legend, grid, axis scale and orientation, and mark geometry. Text questions cover titles, axis titles, category labels, legend entries, tick labels, number format, and text position. Binding questions cover the values encoded by marks, series and category colors, series order, value labels, and simple reasoning over the data.
paragraphs.zh: 问题覆盖范围。 结构类问题涵盖图表类型、类别数量与间距、图例、网格、轴刻度与方向，以及标记几何形状。 文本类问题涵盖标题、轴标题、类别标签、图例条目、刻度标签、数字格式和文本位置。 绑定类问题涵盖标记所编码的值、系列与类别颜色、系列顺序、值标签，以及对数据的简单推理。

paragraphs.en: Protocol. The judge Qwen3.6-35B-A3B answers each atomic question separately with thinking disabled, and its answers are scored by the same deterministic rules as the reader’s. Optical character recognition uses PaddleOCR with rotated reading, so that vertical axis titles are read. For each requested string, we take the best match among the recognized lines. Character similarity is one minus the edit distance to the closest substring, divided by the length of the string.
paragraphs.zh: 协议。 法官 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在禁用思考模式的情况下，对每个原子问题单独作答，其答案将遵循与读者相同的确定性规则进行评分。 光学字符识别使用 PaddleOCR 并启用旋转阅读功能，以便能够读取垂直轴标题。 对于每个请求的字符串，我们从识别出的各行中选取最佳匹配项。 字符相似度等于一减去与最接近子字符串的编辑距离，再除以该字符串的长度。

sents.en: Protocol.

paragraphs.en: The two scorers agree on the direction of change for the overall score, text, and binding on both levels. On L0, both rise over four rounds on all questions (45.7% to 60.2% for U 0 U_{0} and 37.4% to 57.9% for the judge), on text (56.8% to 91.7% and 23.9% to 78.6%), and on binding (13.6% to 28.9% and 10.0% to 26.8%). On L1, both rise on all questions (45.1% to 56.2% and 37.5% to 50.0%), on text (54.2% to 80.2% and 23.6% to 45.7%), and on binding (13.6% to 23.6% and 10.3% to 23.3%). They differ on structure. Both see structure fall after the first round, but the judge sees it rise above its starting level by the third round (90.1% to 91.9% on L0 and 90.2% to 93.3% on L1). U 0 U_{0} stays below its starting level on L0 (87.3% to 85.4% after round 4) and exceeds it on L1 only in round 4 (86.9% to 87.9%). The judge is much stricter on text, so its absolute scores are lower, and we therefore compare trends rather than levels.
paragraphs.zh: 两位评分智能体对总分、文本和约束在两个层级上的变化方向达成一致。 在 L0 层级，所有问题上的得分均随四轮上升（U 0 U_{0} 从 45.7% 升至 60.2%，裁判从 37.4% 升至 57.9%），文本得分从 56.8% 升至 91.7%，另一项从 23.9% 升至 78.6%，约束得分从 13.6% 升至 28.9%，另一项从 10.0% 升至 26.8%。 在 L1 层级，所有问题上的得分均上升（从 45.1% 升至 56.2%，另一项从 37.5% 升至 50.0%），文本得分从 54.2% 升至 80.2%，另一项从 23.6% 升至 45.7%，约束得分从 13.6% 升至 23.6%，另一项从 10.3% 升至 23.3%。 它们在结构方面存在分歧。 两者都认为结构在第一轮后下降，但裁判认为到第三轮时结构已回升至初始水平之上（L0 从 90.1% 升至 91.9%，L1 从 90.2% 升至 93.3%）。 U 0 U_{0} 在 L0 层级始终低于其初始水平（第 4 轮后为 87.3% 至 85.4%），而在 L1 层级仅在第 4 轮超过初始水平（从 86.9% 升至 87.9%）。 裁判对文本的要求更为严格，因此其绝对得分较低，所以我们比较趋势而非具体水平。

paragraphs.en: Images and Questions. The audit uses one shared pool of native images, so that all readers are compared on identical inputs. The pool contains generations of the diagnostic set by M 0 M_{0} and by the models after rounds 1, 2, and 3, since these are the images the readers U 0 U_{0} to U 3 U_{3} had to diagnose. Each model contributes 49 images, 7 per chart type, drawn from disjoint requests, and each image contributes two questions from different question groups. The 196 images give 392 questions, 133 on structure, 133 on text, and 126 on binding. Humans marked 179 requirements as not shown (45.7%) and none as unreadable.
paragraphs.zh: 图像与问题。 此次审计使用一个共享的原生图像池，以便所有阅读器都基于相同的输入进行比较。 该图像池包含由 M 0 M_{0} 生成的诊断集，以及模型在第 1、2 和 3 轮之后生成的图像，因为这些是阅读器 U 0 U_{0} 到 U 3 U_{3} 必须诊断的图像。 每个模型贡献 49 张图像（每张图表类型 7 张），这些图像来自互不重叠的请求，每张图像包含来自不同问题组的两个问题。 这 196 张图像共提供了 392 个问题，其中 133 个关于结构，133 个关于文本，126 个关于绑定。 人类标注者将 179 个要求标记为“未显示”（45.7%），没有标记任何要求为“无法阅读”。

It shows whether the reader ranks weaknesses in the same order as humans, which is what the allocation rules use.

paragraphs.en: Results. Reading of native generations improves less than reading of renders. Accuracy rises from 78.5% for U 0 U_{0} to 81.4%, 82.1%, and 82.4% for U 1 U_{1} to U 3 U_{3} . The gain of U 3 U_{3} over U 0 U_{0} is 3.9%, with a 95% interval of [0.0, 7.9] from resampling images, so it is at the edge of what 392 questions can resolve. All of the gain comes from fewer false rejections, which fall from 10.6% to 3.8%, mostly on text (76.7% to 85.7%). False acceptances do not fall. Each reader still accepts about a third of the requirements that humans mark as not shown (34.1% for U 0 U_{0} and U 3 U_{3} , 38.0% for U 1 U_{1} ), and accuracy on binding stays near 75%. The reader thus becomes less strict where it was wrongly strict but does not become better at catching real errors in the model’s own images, unlike on edited renders (Table 5 ). The ranking of weaknesses is good from the start and improves a little. The correlation between the violation rates of reader and humans across pairs of chart type and question group is 0.82 for U 0 U_{0} and 0.86 to 0.91 for U 1 U_{1} to U 3 U_{3} . Since the allocation rules depend on this ranking rather than on exact rates, the diagnosis points the data to the right places even though about a third of real errors go unreported.

paragraphs.en: A Pre-Study Check. Before the first round, 210 questions were labeled on 105 native images of M 0 M_{0} from an earlier development set (seven chart types, three difficulty levels, five images each, and two questions from different groups per image). The same blind protocol was used. Of the 210 requirements, 72 were labeled shown, 138 not shown, and none unreadable. The initial reader agreed with 76.2% of the labels: 88% on structure and binding, and 47% on text. It mostly accepted text that was labeled as not shown. This check led us, before any round, to report optical character recognition alongside the reader for text. The development set is not one of the request sets in Appendix B , and these labels are not part of any reported result.
paragraphs.zh: 一项预研究检查。 在第一轮之前，对来自早期开发集（7种图表类型、3个难度等级、每种5张图像，每张图像包含来自不同组的2个问题）中M 0 M_{0}的105张原始图像上的210个问题进行了标注。 采用了相同的盲评方案。 在210个要求中，有72个被标注为“已显示”，138个被标注为“未显示”，没有不可读的情况。 初始阅读器与76.2%的标注结果一致：结构部分为88%，结合部分为47%，文本部分为47%。 它主要接受了被标注为“未显示”的文本。 这项检查促使我们在任何一轮开始前，在文本处理时同时报告光学字符识别的结果。 开发集并非附录B中请求集之一，且这些标注不属于任何已报告的结果。

paragraphs.en: Before round 1. Three fixes were made while the data of round 1 were built, before any training. The pairing of number formats with prompt formats was changed from a fixed probability to a rate that divides the target share by the frequency of the value, because the fixed rate sent 92% of the first-round prompts to one format. The overall share of prompts in the mixed format was then held between 40% and 60%. The content checker was fixed for line charts whose programs plot category names directly, which it had rejected almost always, and the saved traces of round 1 were checked again without running the programs again.
paragraphs.zh: 第 1 轮之前。 在第 1 轮的数据构建过程中，在开始任何训练之前，进行了三项修复。 数字格式与提示格式的配对方式从固定概率改为一种新比率：该比率将目标份额除以值的出现频率，因为固定比率导致首轮提示中有 92% 被分配给单一格式。 随后，混合格式提示的整体占比被控制在 40% 到 60% 之间。 对于程序会直接绘制类别名称的折线图，内容检查器进行了修复（此前几乎总是拒绝这类图表），并且重新检查了第 1 轮保存的轨迹，而无需再次运行程序。
